registration: Candidate C. One full CPU 14 s on the frozen center ball scene; reference and shooting prefix unchanged, same bilateral entry after the source clip. Preserve failed A and B. Compare all 14 s against original limits, non-foot 20 N, goal and 200 Hz tail with both feet >30N. No post-hoc rejection.
mechanism: Contact-constrained original-URDF inverse dynamics of stationary feet, 3-D center of mass, pelvis orientation and 29-joint posture using true state. Map desired torques into position commands of original implicit drives. Support wrenches are estimated for distributing torques only; no applied ground/body/ball forces. This implementation uses weighted least squares and does not enforce friction or support-polygon wrench inequalities.
source: Herzog et al. 2016, Momentum Control with Hierarchical Inverse Dynamics on a Torque-Controlled Humanoid. https://is.mpg.de/ei/publications/herzog_momentum_2016
